title: GLB Pulley System Lifting Cargo Box with Rope Tension
prompt:
Create a single HTML file with an interactive 3D pulley system physics simulation using Three.js and GLTFLoader. Load TWO GLB assets: 'SpecularSilkPouf.glb' as the counterweight hanging on one side of the pulley, and 'VirtualCity.glb' as the cargo/payload being lifted on the other side. Build a complete, physically accurate pulley system scene.

SCENE SETUP:
- Use a PerspectiveCamera at position (8, 6, 10) looking at origin.
- Add ambient light (intensity 0.4) and a directional light at (5, 15, 8) with intensity 1.0 and shadow mapping enabled.
- Create a ground plane (50x50, gray #555555) at y=0 with receiveShadow.
- Build a pulley support structure: a tall vertical post (box geometry, 0.3x12x0.3, dark brown #4a3520) at x=0, z=0, and a horizontal beam (0.3x0.3x6) at y=12 extending from x=-3 to x=3.
- Create a pulley wheel at the end of the horizontal beam (torus geometry, radius 0.5, tube 0.08) at position (0, 12, 0). The wheel should visually rotate when rope moves.
- Render ropes as THREE.Line objects (yellow #ffcc00, linewidth 2): one rope segment from the counterweight (left side, x=-2) up and over the pulley wheel, then down to the cargo (right side, x=2).

GLB MODEL LOADING:
- Load 'SpecularSilkPouf.glb' using GLTFLoader. Scale it to fit roughly 1.5x1.5x1.5 units. This is the COUNTERWEIGHT. Position it on the left rope at (x=-2, y=5, z=0). It hangs from the left side of the pulley.
- Load 'VirtualCity.glb' using GLTFLoader. Scale it to fit roughly 2x2x2 units. This is the CARGO. Position it on the right rope at (x=2, y=1, z=0). It sits near the ground initially.
- Both models must cast shadows.

PHYSICS SIMULATION:
- Implement a simple Atwood machine physics model. The counterweight has mass = 15 kg. The cargo has initial mass = 10 kg (can be changed).
- Gravity g = 9.81 m/s².
- Net force = (counterweightMass - cargoMass) * g. Acceleration a = netForce / (counterweightMass + cargoMass).
- Rope tension T = counterweightMass * (g - a) (or equivalently cargoMass * (g + a)).
- When simulation is running, the heavier side descends and lighter side ascends. Velocity accumulates: v += a * dt. Positions update: counterweight y -= v * dt, cargo y += v * dt (when counterweight is heavier).
- Enforce position bounds: cargo cannot go above y=11.5 (near pulley) and cannot go below y=0.2 (ground). Counterweight similarly bounded between y=0.2 and y=11.5. When either hits a bound, velocity becomes 0 and simulation pauses (equilibrium reached at boundary).
- Track total rope length as constant: counterweightY + cargoY should remain constant (conservation of rope length). Initial rope sum = 5 + 1 = 6. As one goes up by delta, the other goes down by delta.
- Friction coefficient mu = 0.02 applied as deceleration: friction = mu * g, subtract from |acceleration| direction.

USER INTERACTIONS:
1. KEYBOARD 'Space': Toggle simulation running/paused. Starts paused.
2. KEYBOARD 'R': Reset simulation to initial state (cargo at y=1, counterweight at y=5, velocity=0, cargoMass=10, paused).
3. KEYBOARD 'ArrowUp': Increase cargo mass by 1 kg (max 30 kg). Only works when paused.
4. KEYBOARD 'ArrowDown': Decrease cargo mass by 1 kg (min 1 kg). Only works when paused.
5. KEYBOARD 'U': Undo last mass change (maintain a history stack of up to 20 mass changes). Only works when paused.
6. KEYBOARD 'F': Toggle friction on/off (default on).
7. DOM BUTTON 'Apply Brake': Set velocity to 0 immediately (acts as emergency brake while running). Button id='brakeBtn'.
8. DOM BUTTON 'Reverse Load': Swap the masses of counterweight and cargo. Only works when paused. Button id='reverseBtn'.
9. CLICK on either GLB model in the 3D scene (raycasting): Select it and highlight with emissive color (0x333300). Display selected object info in HUD.

HUD / UI:
- Create a HUD overlay div (id='hud', top-left, semi-transparent black background, white text, padding 12px, font-family monospace, z-index 100).
- Display: Cargo Mass, Counterweight Mass, Velocity (2 decimal places), Acceleration (2 decimal places), Rope Tension (2 decimal places in Newtons), Cargo Y, Counterweight Y, Simulation State (Paused/Running), Friction (On/Off), Selected Object name, Rope Length Sum (should stay ~6.0).
- 'brakeBtn' and 'reverseBtn' as styled HTML buttons below the HUD.

STATE MANAGEMENT - CRITICAL:
Expose window.__3D_STATE__ with these fields updated every frame:
{
  sceneReady: boolean (true after both GLBs loaded and scene initialized),
  cargoMass: number (kg),
  counterweightMass: number (kg),
  cargoY: number (current y position of cargo),
  counterweightY: number (current y position of counterweight),
  velocity: number (current velocity, positive = cargo going up),
  acceleration: number (current acceleration),
  ropeTension: number (in Newtons),
  isRunning: boolean,
  frictionEnabled: boolean,
  ropeLengthSum: number (cargoY + counterweightY, should be ~6.0 conserved),
  selectedObject: string|null ('cargo'|'counterweight'|null),
  massHistory: array of previous cargo mass values for undo,
  counterweightLoaded: boolean,
  cargoLoaded: boolean,
  pulleyWheelRotation: number (cumulative rotation of pulley wheel),
  brakesApplied: number (count of times brake was applied),
  reverseCount: number (count of times masses were reversed),
  kineticEnergy: number (0.5 * totalMass * v²),
  potentialEnergy: number (cargoMass*g*cargoY + counterweightMass*g*counterweightY),
  totalEnergy: number (KE + PE, should be roughly conserved minus friction losses)
}

ANIMATION:
- Use requestAnimationFrame with dt capped at 1/60.
- Update pulley wheel rotation proportional to velocity.
- Update rope line vertices to track model positions.
- Smoothly animate all movements.
- OrbitControls for camera (damping enabled).
physics_constraints: Atwood machine: a = (m1-m2)*g/(m1+m2), T = m1*(g-a). Rope length conservation: cargoY + counterweightY = constant (~6.0). Position bounds [0.2, 11.5]. Energy: KE + PE conserved when friction off, decreasing when friction on. Velocity must be NaN-free. Masses must be positive integers.
